summary: Usable and convincing low-poly spear. The 2.604 m documented length closely matches the 2.6 m catalogue reach, and the long, narrow silhouette clearly communicates reach. Both views show a recognizable diamond-section spearhead, continuous grip wrap, ferrules, collar, and pommel—not merely generic primitives. Broad facets, restrained steel/leather/bronze separation, and economical detail fit the Halo CE-era brief. The blade reads slightly small and loses some ridge definition in the bright side render, but remains functional and identifiable. The documented +X direction, integration origin, grip/tip/spearhead markers, and separated components provide useful pivots and attachment points.
